### **Director of Quality and Informatics**

**Status:** Full-time **| Location:** Remote (AZ) w/ Occasional On-Site Presence in Tempe 
**Department:** Quality Management | **Reports To:** CMO 
**FLSA Status:** Exempt | **Pay Class:** Salary 
**Salary Range:** $79,793.00 - $105,455.00

SCHEDULE: 40 HOURS WEEKLY, MONDAY-FRIDAY

### **Position Summary**

The Director of Quality and Informatics plays a pivotal leadership role in ensuring the delivery of high-quality, data-informed behavioral healthcare services. This position is responsible for overseeing quality improvement initiatives, clinical data analysis, and informatics strategies that drive performance outcomes, enhance client care, and support regulatory compliance. The Director will lead their team in developing, implementing, and monitoring evidence-based practices, performance metrics, and data systems. This individual will play a pivotal role in driving population health outcomes across all service lines and advancing the organization's value-based care initiatives.This role requires a dynamic individual with a strong background in healthcare quality, informatics, and behavioral health operations who can bridge clinical excellence with data-driven decision-making.

At CPR, we are committed to making diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging an integral part of our daily operations. We strive to hire and retain talented, diverse, and creative individuals, and we are dedicated to ensuring equitable treatment by promoting fairness and respect at every level of our organization.

### **Knowledge and Skills**

* Experience in clinical quality management, regulatory compliance, and outcome measurement
* Proven leadership and team development skills across interdisciplinary teams
* Knowledge of federal and state regulations, including Board of Medical Facilities Licensing (BMFL), Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS), and Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), as well as the standards for healthcare quality and compliance.
* Well developed understanding of best clinical practices and evidence -based treatment models for behavioral health
* Extensive knowledge of population health, value-based care models, and risk stratification
* Ability to analyze complex data to inform strategic decisions and drive improvement
* Strong project management and process improvement expertise
* Proficiency with healthcare IT systems (EHR, HIE, data integration)
* Excellent verbal and written communication for reporting and stakeholder engagement
* Understanding of Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) and their impact on health outcomes

### **Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead initiatives to enhance clinical quality, including process improvements, audits, and compliance with regulatory standards
* Manage technology systems to support quality improvement and clinical performance, including overseeing EHR optimization and data integration
* Oversee population health management programs, including monitoring and reporting on Value-Based Contracts (VBC) and shared savings agreements
* Collaborate with health plans and other stakeholders to develop and implement targeted interventions for improving patient outcomes and addressing SDOH
* Facilitate cross-functional meetings to ensure alignment with business goals, including regular reviews of VBC performance, quality metrics, and operational efficiencies
* Conduct data analysis and report on performance, outcomes, and opportunities for improvement across all departments
* Lead special projects to drive innovation and efficiency, including Targeted Investments (TI) and Data Analytics & Performance (DAP) initiatives
* Provide oversight of client satisfaction surveys and ensure continuous feedback loops to improve service delivery
* Develop and maintain key strategic partnerships to ensure the success of population health initiatives, with a focus on behavioral health integration
* Provide departmental leadership and supervision to direct reports, including performance management, coaching, hiring, and training
* Manage the department’s budget, resources, and operational strategies to support departmental goals.
* Reliable and predictable attendance is an essential job function.
* Other duties as assigned

### **Qualifications and Education Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, Healthcare Administration, or related field required.
* Minimum of 2 years in a management or supervisory role in behavioral health or healthcare required.
* Master’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, Healthcare Administration, or related field preferred but not required.
* Current, unrestricted license issued by the Arizona Board of Behavioral Health Examiners: LCSW (Licensed Clinical Social Worker), LPC (Licensed Professional Counselor), Ph.D (Doctor of Philosophy), Psy.D (Doctor of Psychology) preferred but not required.

### **Other Requirements**

* Provide evidence of professional liability insurance coverage in the amount acceptable, minimum $1/$3 million.
* Must comply with training and supervision requirements during first 90 days of employment, and throughout employment.
* All licensed, certified, and registered staff will be monitored regarding restrictions.
* Appropriate reference checks by letter and telephone as requested.
* State-required background check.
* Medicare/Medicaid sanctions, criminal violations, subsequent malpractice actions, and any settlement(s) made on behalf of practitioners.
* Within seven (7) days of hire, apply for and/or present and maintain a Class One Fingerprint Clearance card. If application is necessary, a copy must be submitted for inclusion in the personnel file until card (and/or renewals) is received.
* All required renewals must be submitted 30 days prior to expiration date. It is the duty of the licensee to keep all renewals active and current and report any mandated changes to Arizona Board of Behavioral Health Examiners immediately.

Posted Wednesday, November 11, 2026 at 1:00 AM

Jered LLC, a PAR Systems Company, is seeking a Director of Quality is responsible for the overall leadership, strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of Jered’s Quality function across all United States operations. This role has enterprise-level responsibility for ensuring Jered’s products, manufacturing operations, field service activities, and shipboard work consistently meet contractual, regulatory, U.S. Navy, Department of Defense (DoD), customer, and internal Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.

 

The Director of Quality serves as the senior Quality leader for Jered’s U.S. operations and is responsible for establishing a consistent, scalable, and disciplined quality organization capable of supporting the company’s continued growth. This position provides leadership to Quality Engineering, Inspection, and other quality resources across Jered locations and ensures appropriate quality controls are integrated throughout engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, testing, delivery, and field service activities.

 

As a member of Jered’s leadership team, the Director of Quality is expected to proactively identify quality and compliance risks, strengthen processes, develop organizational capability, and partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, and other functions to drive a culture of **“Do It Once, Do It Right.”** In addition, the Director of Quality owns all quality-related customer communications including customer complaints and corrective actions and defect notifications.

 

**Success Criteria**

The successful Director of Quality will be a strategic, results-driven leader who provides clear direction, technical expertise, and accountability across Jered’s U.S. Quality operations. This individual will build a consistent, scalable, and high-performing Quality organization that supports business growth while maintaining the independence and integrity needed to uphold customer, contractual, and regulatory requirements. Success will be demonstrated through measurable improvements in First Pass Yield; reductions in nonconformances, rework, and Cost of Poor Quality; effective corrective and preventive actions; and sustained compliance with ISO 9001, NAVSEA, DoD, and other applicable standards.

 

This leader will strengthen Quality Management Systems, establish consistent processes and performance expectations across multiple locations, and proactively identify and mitigate risks throughout manufacturing, supply chain, testing, delivery, and field service operations. The Director will also develop and mentor Quality teams, strengthen technical competencies and workforce readiness, and build effective partnerships with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, and senior leadership. Through proactive customer engagement, effective issue resolution, data-driven decision-making, and a commitment to continuous improvement, the Director will help shift the organization’s focus from identifying defects to preventing them. Ultimately, success will be reflected in a culture of shared ownership of quality, stronger customer confidence, improved operational performance, and support for Jered’s long-term growth and commitment to “Do It Once, Do It Right.”

 

**Qualifications**

* + Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Business, or a related technical discipline.
 + 10+ years of progressive Quality leadership experience in complex manufacturing, defense, maritime, shipbuilding, or similarly regulated industries.
 + Demonstrated experience leading Quality functions across multiple facilities, programs, or business operations.
 + Significant experience supporting U.S. Navy or DoD shipbuilding, ship repair, fabrication, or maritime manufacturing programs.
 + Strong knowledge of NAVSEA requirements, military specifications, shipyard quality practices, and government contracting environments.
 + Expert level understanding of ISO 9001 and Quality Management System principles.
 + Demonstrated experience with NCR, MRB, CAPA, root cause analysis, audit, supplier quality, and continuous improvement processes.
 + Proven ability to build, lead, develop, and hold accountable Quality Engineering and Inspection organizations.
 + Experience interfacing with U.S. Government representatives, including DCMA and SUPSHIP, as well as major shipyards and defense customers.
 + Demonstrated ability to use data and quality metrics to identify trends, prioritize risks, and drive measurable improvement.
 + Strong leadership, communication, and influencing skills with the ability to work effectively across Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, and senior leadership.
 + Experience with ERP and electronic QMS platforms.
 + Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
 + Ability to obtain and maintain access to military installations, shipyards, and controlled industrial areas.
 + Ability and willingness to travel regularly between Jered U.S. locations, customer facilities, suppliers, and shipyards.
 + Valid, unrestricted U.S. Driver’s License required.
 + US Persons

You’ve learned about what you'll be doing, here are the **benefits** you'll gain when you join our team:

* Global team recognized for their passion of inventing
* First-of-a-kind product culture and project exposure
* Training and development from industry-leading experts
* Cutting edge benefit programs that include: 401(k) & matching; Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance; Disability & Life Insurance; PTO, Paid Holidays, & Parental Leave for both Parents; Tuition Reimbursement
 

Jered, a PAR Systems company is an equal opportunity employer and we value individuals with a variety of backgrounds and experiences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin or any other status protected by applicable law. We use AI to assist with sorting applications, but real humans do all the evaluating and deciding. If selected for an interview, please advise our Human Resources department if you require accommodation during the interview or assessment process and we will support your accessibility needs.

JR2889

**Advancing medicine to save lives. Together.**

Thanks to many decades of experience and our passion for what we do, we make an essential contribution to the global availability of biopharmaceuticals, especially for patients with rare and serious diseases.

Rentschler Biopharma SE is a leading contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) focused exclusively on client projects. We offer customized full-service solutions for bioprocess development and the production of complex biopharmaceuticals. As a German family-owned company with an international footprint and global reach, we combine experts, expertise and years of experience to develop best-in-class solutions – together with our clients.

Rentschler Biopharma has approximately 1,400 employees and is headquartered in Laupheim, Germany, with a site in Milford, MA, USA. In 2024, we joined the United Nations Global Compact, underlining our commitment to sustainability.

As an independent family-owned company, we live by the motto: Many hands, many minds - ONE TEAM! Open, respectful cooperation characterizes our working environment, where quality awareness, diligence and responsibility are our top priorities. With all the diversity of our talents in the Rentschler team, we pursue one vision together: advancing medicine to save lives.

As a member of the QC leadership team in Milford, the Director, Quality Control Technical Services will manage and oversee a Quality Control team responsible for maintaining GxP systems and processes that support site business objectives; within QC this will be from Clinical Development to Clinical Supply and/or Commercial manufacture at a Contract Development & Manufacturing Organization (CDMO). The candidate will work in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Supply Operations, Process Sciences and Quality Assurance to support continual improvement and cGMP compliance. The Director will work functionally as well as part of a multi-disciplinary team to support the development and approval of our clinical development programs, commercial operations, and implement strategic imperatives within a fast-paced environment.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

 

* Will manage teams of professionals within Quality Control encompassing raw materials testing, microbiology, QC LIMS master data and electronic systems, analytical equipment lifecycle management, documentation and data integrity
* Hire and develop employees within the department through coaching and mentorship while setting clear expectations for success
* Leads and manages the Milford Site QC Leadership team meetings and follow up action plans
* Establish and maintain Quality Control systems and processes at Milford, MA site
* Develops and maintains department budgets (expense and capital) in alignment with overall organizational goals for profitability

* Acts as portfolio manager for QC project work including scheduling, prioritizing and resource planning to ensure client contract deliverables are met
* Represents QC at the project team level and interacts with Rentschler clients as needed
* Ensure timely execution of client projects and clear communications to clients
* Identify and initiate improvements to Quality Control Systems and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensuring compliance with all relevant quality standards and regulatory requirements
* Verify & establish department readiness for audits by both internal and external authorities, serve as primary Quality Control contact for regulatory inspections and client audits
* Analyze regulatory authorities’ programs, guidance documents and activities in areas relevant to testing biological products
* Consistently advise site and Quality management of potential and actual actions that could adversely affect the business; represent quality exposures or represent opportunities to be pursued
* Collect and report quality control metrics via Quality Management Reviews and the Quality Council
* Promotes a strong Quality Culture based on the Rentschler core values

**Qualifications and Key Characteristics**

 

* BS required, MS preferred in a scientific/technical discipline with 15+ years of experience in a QC position within the biological and/or CDMO industry
* 10+ years in a management/leadership role(s)
* PhD in a scientific/technical discipline a plus
* Experience in microbiological methods and contamination control
* Subject matter experiment in laboratory equipment qualification and data management
* Ability to apply GMP regulations and international guidelines to all aspects of the position
* Experience with regulatory inspections and client audits specifically within a startup/early phase and commercial QC laboratories
* Extensive experience with writing and managing investigations and risk assessments
* Proficient in MS Office application suite as well GMP electronic applications such as LIMS
* Outstanding leadership abilities with demonstrated analytical and critical thinking skills while managing high performing teams
* Proven leader, delegator, and decision maker with the ability to interact with all levels
* Executive presence with strong interpersonal and communication skills, verbal and written

**Working Conditions**

 

* Manufacturing environment with potential chemical, electrical and physical hazards
* Personal protective equipment must be worn in the laboratories according to Rentschler safety requirements
* Exposure to cool/hot storage conditions
* May be working in a loud area at times, that requires hearing protection and other protective equipment to be worn
* Working around chemicals such as solvents, acids, bases and reactive or flammable materials
* May require immunization before performing work within the manufacturing area
* Pace may be fast and job completion demands may be high
* Some international travel (no more than 5% time)

**Physical Requirements**

 

* May be required to stand for long periods of time while performing physical duties
* May be required to lift up to 10 lbs
* Must be able to work safely with materials and equipment
* PPE as required

Base Pay Range 
 
$180,000 - $220,000

**Reporting:** 
Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

**Direct Reports:** 
Area Manager(s)

**Leadership Scope:** 
Provides leadership and oversight to all Operations team members, including Senior Multi-Unit Managers, Multi-Unit Managers, Hourly Managers, and Guest Service Hosts.

**Description:**

The Vice President of Operations is the steward of our organizational identity, bridging the field and support center teams. They spend time in the field listening to frontline employees, then bring those insights to the executive table to shape decisions. In turn, they translate corporate priorities into clear, purposeful action for each location following the principles of Unreasonable Hospitality.

More than anything, they are the guardian of what makes us *us*: the values, traditions, and shared ways of working that bind our people together. They ensure those values are felt in every location by recognizing great work, modeling expected behaviors, and making sure every employee feels seen, heard, and proud to belong.

This role has two main objectives: setting and executing the company’s operational strategy across its retail video gaming (VGT) locations, and building and leading the Operations leadership team. It requires a service-oriented, strategic, and results-driven executive who prioritizes guest satisfaction while ensuring smooth, compliant, and profitable operations that support the company’s long-term growth.

**Expectations:**

* Lead with integrity and honesty in all work-related duties and set the standard for the organization.
* Provide proactive, strategic leadership over the operations of all company locations.
* Empower and support the Operations team to meet or exceed performance standards.
* Maintain a deep working knowledge of every area of operations and step in to assist when necessary.
* Develop a positive and collaborative work environment for employees, guests, vendors, and regulators.
* Ensure the company meets state, local, and company standards and regulations, including gaming and liquor requirements.
* Maintain clear and consistent communication with the CEO, executive team, employees, managers, and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities:**

**Executive Leadership and Culture**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to the executive team and participate in setting company vision, strategy, and annual goals.
* Be a champion of company culture by leading with integrity, kindness, and a strong commitment to company values.
* Foster a mentor mentality by teaching and leading by example, asking questions to ensure clarity, and consistently following up to reinforce learning and ensure progress.
* Build, coach, and hold accountable the Operations team.
* Lead succession planning and talent development across all levels of operations leadership.
* Provide regular operational and financial updates to the executive team.

**Operations and Guest Experience**

* Take ownership of operations across all locations and establish company-wide standards for guest service, cleanliness, and sanitation.
* Teach, demonstrate, and guide the organization toward exceptional guest service, creating memorable experiences every shift, every day, every time.
* Drive operational efficiency through impactful leadership and accountability at all levels, identifying opportunities and resolving challenges to ensure smooth, continuous operations.
* Establish and monitor operating procedures for inventory, ordering, scheduling, timecards, and store audits, and verify they are consistently followed.
* Be knowledgeable of VGT machines, slot games, and features, and ensure teams are equipped to resolve machine issues.
* Evaluate and implement process improvements that increase efficiency and consistency across locations.

**People Management**

* Partner with Human Resources to ensure proper staffing levels, training and development of team members, disciplinary actions, and overall performance management.
* Establish compensation, staffing, and labor-budget guidelines for operations in partnership with the CEO and Human Resources.
* Maintain consistent communication with all levels of the organization, including in-person visits, camera monitoring, phone calls, and team meetings.
* Facilitate regular meetings with the Area Manager(s), Operations team, and business partners to ensure thorough follow-through on all business needs.
* Support a culture of continuous training and development for new and existing team members.

**Financial Performance**

* Own the company's operating P&L, including VGT performance and controllable expenses, ensuring results stay within budget while driving profitability.
* Develop annual operating budgets, and capital plans in partnership with the CEO and CFO.
* Analyze monthly P&Ls and key performance indicators and hold the leadership team accountable for results.
* Ensure strong internal controls over cash handling, deposit processes, and sales activities across all locations.

**Licensing, Compliance, and Regulatory Relations**

* Oversee the company's licensing and compliance program to ensure adherence to state and local regulations and standards.
* Serve as a key point of contact with regulators, including the Illinois Gaming Board (IGB), and maintain professional relationships with regulatory and local authorities.
* Uphold company policies and licensing standards, including liquor and gaming regulations, to protect employees and guests.
* Ensure a safe and compliant work environment by following local health codes and business license regulations.
* Ensure all employees complete required certification courses and that audits are completed and corrective actions are followed through.
* Reinforce a zero-tolerance standard to prohibit underage patrons from purchasing alcohol or gambling by IDing every guest, every time.

**Growth, Market Strategy, and Marketing**

* Identify and evaluate opportunities for growth, including new locations and market expansion.
* Analyze each local market through competitive shops, daily reports, and monthly revenue reports from the IGB.
* Champion marketing initiatives and promotional campaigns, ensuring effective implementation across all locations.
* Provide strategic direction to the leadership team to drive successful marketing initiatives and promotions.

**Safety, Security, and Systems**

* Maintain a safe working environment by overseeing safety programs, ensuring concerns are reported and resolved.
* Ensure key and alarm code tracking, camera monitoring, and security procedures are followed at all locations.
* Ensure internal systems such as ShiftNotes, Guardian, and the Point-of-Sale system are maintained and updated.

**Facilities, Vendors, and Risk Management**

* Oversee repair and maintenance programs to ensure equipment, facilities, and systems operate efficiently.
* Take a proactive approach to identifying and addressing operational risk before problems escalate.
* Manage key vendor, contractor, and partner relationships, including negotiating and reviewing service agreements in partnership with the CEO.

**Other Duties**

* Perform other duties as requested by the CEO.

**Skills & Experience:**

* Must be 21 years of age.
* Extensive multi-unit or multi-location leadership experience, including leading managers and directors.
* Experience in gaming, hospitality, restaurant, or retail operations is preferred.
* Proven track record of owning a P&L, budgeting, forecasting, and driving profitable growth.
* Working knowledge of gaming and liquor regulations, including Illinois Gaming Board requirements, strongly preferred.
* Strong executive presence with excellent communication, interpersonal, and team leadership skills.
* Must have access to reliable transportation and be available to travel to all locations during business hours.
* Must be able to bend, reach, lift, and/or carry 50 pounds.
* Must be able to maintain an active and engaged floor presence for periods exceeding 60 minutes.
* Attend meetings and trainings as required.

Vera Therapeutics is a commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on the pursuit of truth in science to transform medicine in autoimmune disease, starting with the kidney. Vera Therapeutics’ flagship commercial product is TRUTAKNA TM (atacicept-vymj), a B-cell activating factor (BAFF) and A proliferation-inducing ligand ( APRIL) inhibitor. Vera Therapeutics is evaluating multiple diseases where the reduction of autoantibodies through inhibition of BAFF and APRIL may prove clinically meaningful. Vera Therapeutics was founded in 2016 and is based in Brisbane, California. To learn more, visit www.veratx.com .

 

 At Vera, our values are the cornerstone of our culture and guide how we work together every day. We lead with empathy, act with an owner’s mindset, demand clarity, work without fences, and execute with urgency because patients are counting on us. From how we hire and develop our people to how we advance rigorous science, we are building a team committed to transforming medicine in autoimmune diseases, starting with the kidney. 

 
 
 
 
 Position Summary: 

 
 
 
 
 This position is responsible for creating, directing, and managing the company’s infrastructure and staff to support the operational aspects of the pharmacovigilance operations and compliance system to adhere to all global regulatory requirements and internal processes and procedures. The qualified candidate will have experience in and perform multiple activities related to overall safety operations strategy across the portfolio, including oversight of case management, database strategy, vendor oversight, compliance, inspection readiness, contracts, departmental strategy and training. In addition, this position must build and maintain relationships with key strategic internal and external stakeholders, including the hiring and development of Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance (DSPV) personnel. As a member of the DSPV leadership team, this role partners closely with the Head of DSPV to shape PV Operations strategy, own budget and resourcing decisions, and represent DSPV Operations to senior leadership and external partners.

 
 
 
 
 Responsibilities: 

 
 
 
 
 
 Own and drive global PV Operations strategy, including planning, implementation, and management, in the US and globally internationally, in close alignment with the Head of DSPV on portfolio-level risk, resourcing, and business priorities.

 Serve as a key advisor to the Head of DSPV on operational risk, resource allocation, and DSPV budget planning; own accountability for the DSPV Operations budget, including CRO and vendor contract spend.

 Represent DSPV Operations in interactions with senior leadership and, as needed, and support due diligence activities (e.g., licensing, partnerships, M&A).

 Manage internal and external staff allocated to operational PV activities, creating a highly efficient team.

 Own talent strategy for PV Operations, including hiring, development, performance management, and succession planning.

 Provide expert guidance and leadership both internally and externally based on in-depth knowledge of development and post-marketing safety requirements, per ICH, US and international regulations and guidelines, and Good Pharmacovigilance Practice.

 Build and implement pharmacovigilance systems that are fully compliant with the applicable worldwide Health Authority PV regulations.

 Provide oversight of systems and MedDRA updates in collaboration with the relevant PV vendor.

 Contribute to the selection of PV vendors to support an outsourced PV business model. Provide vendor oversight and management for all outsourced or insourced PV activities, including establishing and monitoring key quality and compliance metrics, invoicing and budgetary needs related to operations and compliance.

 Develop and implement an inspection readiness program with the contribution of other PV and non-PV stakeholders.

 Serve as the PV Operations lead/host during Health Authority inspections and audits (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA), coordinating responses and remediation.

 Responsible for a compliant and quality execution of all operational activities related to case management and related activities. Oversee timely submissions of expedited reports to the FDA and other health authorities in conjunction with Regulatory.

 Establish a system for identifying, preventing, and correcting compliance deviation, including applicable corrective and preventive actions, in collaboration with the Quality group and internal/external stakeholders, to maintain reporting compliance at the highest level.

 Oversee the setup of new safety projects, including development of study-specific Safety Management Plans and setup of safety systems and database configurations in the PV database to accommodate these trials and products.

 Contribute to, draft, and implement department SOPs and work instructions related to the PV activities.

 Contribute to the signal detection, benefit-risk profile assessment, and aggregate reporting activities with providing accurate reports from the safety database.

 Effectively collaborate with key stakeholders at all levels in the organization, including Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Legal, Medical Affairs, and Manufacturing to develop compliant procedures in line with industry standards and best practices.

 Represent PV Operations as a leader on project teams, cross-functional committees, and governance bodies (e.g., Safety Management Team), providing operational input to signal review and safety governance processes.

 Elevate a quality mindset across DSPV.

 Lead training activities, including setting training requirements and training compliance.

 Build and oversee PV regulatory intelligence activities.

 
 

 
 
 
 
 Qualifications: 

 
 
 
 
 
 Healthcare or life sciences degree required; advanced degree (e.g., PharmD, RN, MPH, or scientific PhD) preferred.

 15+ years of pharmacovigilance experience, including 5+ years in a people-leadership role managing global PV teams.

 Experience with clinical and commercial lifecycle phases is required.

 Demonstrated experience managing PV Operations through multiple Health Authority inspections (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA).

 Experience spanning both clinical-stage and commercial/post-marketing environments, ideally across multiple therapeutic areas.

 Skilled in process gap assessments and process enhancements.

 Strategic thinker.

 Strong execution and drive for results skills.

 Comfortable working independently.

 Deep knowledge of pharmacovigilance regulations and guidelines.

 
 
 
 
 Vera Therapeutics Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer.

 Vera Therapeutics is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices and we strive to provide employees with total compensation packages that are market competitive. The exact base pay offered for this role will depend on various factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s geography, qualifications, skills, and experience.

 For this role, the anticipated base pay range is
 $270,000 — $370,000 USD 


 At Vera, base pay is only one part of your total compensation package. The successful candidate will be eligible for an annual performance incentive bonus, new hire equity, and ongoing performance-based equity. Vera Therapeutics also offers various benefits offerings, including, but not limited to, medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k match, flexible time off, and a number of paid holidays.

 Recruiters and staffing agencies should not contact Vera Therapeutics through this page. All recruitment vendors (search firms, recruitment agencies, and staffing companies) are prohibited from contacting our hiring manager(s), executive team members, or employees.

 We require that all recruiters and staffing agencies have a fully executed, formal written agreement on file.

 Vera Therapeutics’ receipt or acceptance of an unsolicited resume submitted by a vendor organization to this website or employee does not constitute an actual or implied contract between Vera Therapeutics and such organization and will be considered unsolicited and Vera Therapeutics will not be responsible for related fees.

 Fraud Alert

 Recruiters will always contact you using the domain of veratx.com. We will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information like social security numbers. If you are unsure if a message is from Vera Therapeutics, please email human resources.

 The IT Director- Manufacturing and Supply Chain Technology is a senior technology leader within the Business Technology Management group responsible for the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of enterprise systems that enable manufacturing, supply chain, and operations. This role requires deep experience in the manufacturing and supply chain verticals, with expertise in SAP ECC–based ERP environments and tightly integrated operational technologies.

 Technology Strategy & Roadmap 
 Define and execute the multi-year technology roadmap for manufacturing and supply chain systems aligned to business growth objectives.

 Own the strategy and lifecycle management of SAP ECC across production planning (PP), materials management (MM), sales & distribution (SD), quality management (QM), plant maintenance (PM), and OTC integrations

 Ensure alignment between ERP, procurement, planning, and shop-floor systems to enable end-to-end process visibility.

 Evaluate and modernize SIOP planning capabilities to improve forecast accuracy, capacity planning, and inventory optimization.

 
 Manufacturing Systems Leadership 
 Lead strategy and governance for MES platforms, ensuring tight integration between shop-floor control systems and SAP ECC.

 Drive digitization initiatives across production, quality, maintenance, and traceability.

 Oversee WMS and TMS platforms to ensure seamless warehouse execution, logistics optimization, and transportation visibility.

 Improve plant-level KPIs through system enablement and data integrity.

 
 SAP & Supply Chain Optimization 
 Oversee end-to-end integration between SAP ECC , SAP Ariba , SIOP planning tools, and TMS

 Ensure procurement workflows, supplier collaboration, and spend management are optimized within Ariba.

 Drive master data governance across materials, BOMs, routings, vendors, customers, and logistics networks.

 Partner with Finance to ensure accurate cost accounting, inventory valuation, and manufacturing variance reporting.

 
  O perational Excellence & Reliability 
 Working within our established IT Operating Model, establish strong IT-business governance with manufacturing, supply chain, and procurement leadership.

 Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance across mission-critical operational platforms.

 Lead continuous improvement initiatives

 Implement strong change management practices to ensure adoption across plant and warehouse environments.

 
 Team & Vendor Leadership 
 Build and lead high-performing ERP, Manufacturing, OTC, Product Lifecycle Management and supply chain technology teams (internal and external).

 Manage system integrators, managed services providers, and software vendors.

 Establish clear SLAs and performance metrics for operational support and project delivery.

 Develop internal capability in SAP ECC manufacturing and supply chain modules.

 
 Minimum Job Requirements 
 
 Education 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Business, or related field or equivalent experience
 
 Work Experience 
 12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience in the manufacturing sector

 Deep hands-on functional and technical expertise in SAP ECC 

 Proven experience implementing and optimizing MES, WMS, and TMS solutions within complex manufacturing environments.

 Demonstrated experience leading SIOP (Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning) system enablement.

 Experience integrating SAP Ariba with SAP ECC environments.

 Strong understanding of manufacturing costing, supply chain planning, inventory optimization, and logistics execution

 
 Knowledge / Skills / Abilities 
 Deeply knowledgeable in manufacturing operations and plant-floor realities—not just enterprise IT.

 Fluent in SAP ECC manufacturing and supply chain processes.

 Data-driven and operationally rigorous.

 Capable of translating operational strategy into scalable technology solutions.

 Comfortable operating in complex, multi-plant environments where uptime and execution discipline are critical.

 
 Preferred Job Requirements 
 
 Education 
 MBA
 Work Experience 
 5+ years of ERP leadership in an organization executing acquisitions

Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

**About Blue Origin** 
We are a team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety. These positions will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable spaceflight. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin's vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.

 

As a Sr. Director for Manufacturing at Blue Origin’s manufacturing, production, and launch facilities, this role will have a direct impact on the success of Blue’s mission.

We are looking for senior leaders to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required.

 

**About This Opportunity** 
Blue Origin is actively building its senior manufacturing and operations leadership team across multiple sites. We are seeking an experienced Sr. Director with a strong aerospace background to lead high-performing teams in support of our rocket production program. This role will span the following functional areas:

Manufacturing and Integration
 
Provides senior leadership across production operations including structural fabrication, thermal protection systems, systems integration, testing, and final assembly for Blue Origin’s booster manufacturing. Responsible for establishing and maintaining process controls, driving production efficiency, and ensuring safe, repeatable spaceflight hardware delivery at all stages of the product lifecycle. This role will also provide leadership across integration operations supporting the assembly and verification of complex space systems, launch vehicles, and propulsion hardware. Accountable for coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure the safe, on-time integration of hardware in alignment with engineering requirements, mission assurance standards, and program milestones.

**Key Responsibilities:** 
Leaders across these functional areas are expected to:
 

* Lead and develop teams of Managers, Senior Managers, and Directors driving manufacturing and operations execution across space and propulsion programs
* Champion a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement across all functional teams
* Own departmental KPIs, budgets, staffing plans, and capital project portfolios
* Partner with Program Management, Site Leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders to meet production schedules and customer expectations
* Drive process definition, development, deployment, and improvement initiatives including Lean Manufacturing and root cause analysis
* Collaborate with engineering teams to advance Design for Manufacturability principles and accelerate the transition from development to production
* Implement and mature production frameworks that support world-class manufacturing capabilities
* Communicate and enforce mission assurance and safety principles throughout the organization
* Recruit, develop, coach, and mentor talent at all levels of the organization

 
**Minimum Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Aerospace, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience
* 15 or more years of progressive experience in aerospace manufacturing or a closely related industry, such as launch vehicles, aircraft, spacecraft systems, or defense
* 5 or more years in a senior leadership role managing managers and large, cross-functional teams
* Demonstrated experience leading manufacturing and operations teams in fast-paced, complex environments

 

**Preferred Qualifications:** 

* Master's degree, MBA, or advanced degree in a relevant engineering or business field
* Prior experience in aerospace environments supporting space hardware, rocket propulsion, or other mission-critical, high-value components
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, the Toyota Production System, or Six Sigma; Black Belt certification preferred
* Experience transitioning manufacturing capabilities from development and prototyping into full-rate production
* Knowledge of fabrication processes including machining, welding, composites, additive manufacturing, cleaning, and non-destructive testing
* Experience with facility activation, new production line startup, or multi-site manufacturing operations
* Proficiency with MRP/ERP, PLM, and Manufacturing Execution Systems

 

Base Pay Range for:

WA applicants is $203,165.00 - $284,430.30

**Other site ranges may differ**

 

**Culture Statement**

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

 

**Export Control Regulations**

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

 

**Background Check**

* Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical 

 

**Benefits**

* Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
* Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
* Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details. 

 

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws.

 

**Affirmative Action and Disability Accommodation**

Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at EEOCompliance@blueorigin.com . Please note this is a publicly managed inbox. Please do not include any personal medical information in your request.

record.EMPLOYER_PRIMARY_BUSINESS:
Location: New York, NY, United States
 
Date Posted: Nov 11, 2026

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

At A&M, the North American Data and AI team, IQx (Official name to be announced) SBU is combining A&M's market-leading execution with AI and digital expertise to help clients redesign processes, improve performance and achieve better outcomes. Come be part of the launch of this cutting-edge team that is making an impact on A&M’s future. Join us in making a difference.

We are seeking a Operations Director to join our team. This position is an internal role within A&M’s IQx operations team, reporting directly to the COO and Finance lead for IQx.

We value a healthy work-life balance and promote in-person collaboration by providing a flexible remote work arrangement with select days in the office, as needed. Ideal office locations are New York City or Philadelphia, but this is flexible.

We offer excellent opportunities for career advancement and building leadership skills. Our business is committed to each team member’s development, training, and exposure to business leaders.

**How you will contribute**

As an Operationsirector, your primary responsibility will be for program management, resource management, onboarding activities, supporting the growth for our business, and helping us thrive to achieve our goals. The Operations Director is expected to grow to support the operations functions of the IQx business more broadly. Your primary responsibilities as we launch will include:

* Lead program management for IQx, including planning, tracking, and driving to completion the initiatives that support the launch and growth of the business
* Support and drive internal initiatives, coordinating across stakeholders, managing timelines and deliverables, and reporting progress to leadership
* Establish and run IQx meeting cadences (e.g., leadership, staffing, and pipeline reviews), including agendas, materials, action tracking, and follow-up
* Help set up and scale the IQx practice, building the operating processes, tools, and governance that will support the team as it grows
* Go-to person for all staffing matters for our business unit
* Assess and plan future resource requirements, driving utilization based on a thorough understanding of current and future project pipeline.
* Build relationships across the business with internal stakeholders including Senior Management, Talent Acquisition, HR, Finance and Operations teams
* Effectively plan for, and advise on conflicts and issues, on a regular basis, prioritizing based on commercial needs and key skills available
* Build awareness of individuals’ performance goals and development needs, influencing resourcing decisions that further the continuation of business and individuals’ skill-set development
* Advanced use of staffing/ workforce planning tools, AI and reporting (for example Profinda, Claude, PowerBI) in measuring utilization and influencing staffing decisions
* Collaborate extensively with the wider Resource Management teams across North America and globally, as required by project needs

**Qualifications**

The ideal candidate will be excited about becoming a true strategic partner for our business. We are looking for people who are personable, knowledgeable, entrepreneurial, and fun. A unique blend of qualities that cannot be fast-tracked into existence. You possess desirable qualities such as being anticipatory, engaged, and respectful, which earns the respect of others. Other preferred experience includes:

* Program management experience, with a track record of leading cross-functional initiatives, managing multiple workstreams, and setting up operating rhythms and meeting cadences
* Resource Manager with several years of experience in a consulting firm or matrix organization; experience in Ops, HR or Recruitment role also beneficial for the role
* Able to effectively partner with Business Leaders and other Resource Managers in the firm, working closely with the wider North America Resource Management leads
* Excellent relationship building skills, communicating with Business Leaders and staff
* Able to manage staffing by efficiently prioritizing multiple competing demands and dealing with tight deadlines
* Able to present meaningful reporting insights to senior leadership, delivering key resourcing messages and driving agreed-upon actions
* Degree educated with several years of work experience in a professional services or corporate environment
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, and knowledgeable in AI as well as resource planning tools
* Previous experience using a Resource Management/ Planning tool would be advantageous but not essential
* Keen to take on responsibility and grow the role
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, and drive positive change
* Strong time management skills with the ability to plan and priorities workload
* High degree of accuracy and attention to detail
* Use initiative to solve problems and make appropriate recommendations for resourcing decisions
* Works well under pressure and with challenging individuals
* Keen to take ownership of resourcing problems and motivated to deliver value

If you see yourself in this description, we want to hear from you!

*How will you grow and be supported?*

Our team prides itself on sustaining a culture that reflects our core values. We value integrity, quality, and objectivity in our work. We believe every day is a choice, and so we like what we do and with whom we do it. We embrace diversity, foster inclusiveness, and reward merit. We encourage and support our employees and communities through ongoing investments from leadership, social and networking events, peer-to-peer networks, Employee Resource Groups, volunteer opportunities, and pro-bono work. We are committed to promoting an inclusive environment in which all can develop, grow, and be supported.

**Your journey at A&M**

We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.

We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive an annual discretionary contribution to their 401(k) retirement savings plan from Alvarez & Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A&M’s benefits programs.

The salary range is $150,000 - $170,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.

**Culture & Values**
--------------------

At Alvarez & Marsal, our core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide everything we do, shaping a culture rooted in entrepreneurship, impact, and integrity. We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. Above all, we value doing the right thing. For those ready to roll up their sleeves, lead with integrity, and be difference makers, this is where it starts.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

It is Alvarez & Marsal’s practice to provide and promote equal opportunity in employment, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment without discrimination because of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex or gender, gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, family medical history, genetic information or other protected medical condition, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by and in accordance with applicable laws. Employees and Applicants can find A&M policy statements and additional information by region here.

**Unsolicited Resumes from Third-Party Recruiters**
---------------------------------------------------

Please note that as per A&M policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters unless such recruiters are engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that A&M will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.

**Job Description:**

**JOB SUMMARY**

Owns overall site performance and full P&L responsibility for the plant. Accountable for delivering Safety, Quality, Customer Service, and Cost commitments while building the organization, systems, and continuous improvement capability required to scale the operation from commissioning through full-rate production.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**P&L & Cost Management**

* Owns the plant P&L: develops, proposes, and manages the annual operating and capital budgets; drives cost, margin, and productivity performance against plan and explains variances with corrective action plans.
* Reviews, proposes, and approves as appropriate plans controlling budget spending, labor efficiency, material efficiency, engineering effectiveness, and customer service.
* Reviews cost control reports, cost estimates, headcount utilization, and conversion cost per unit for the operation.
* Reviews and proposes projects involving functional or organizational changes within the operation; builds the business case and tracks realized benefit.

**Operations & Production Standards**

* Maintains production operations standards consistent with company and site Safety, Quality, Productivity, and Cost requirements in order to exceed customer expectations (annual plant objectives and monthly scorecard).
* Reviews performance against operating plans and standards; requires interpretation of results from direct reports and approves changes in direction of plans.
* Resolves priority conflicts across lines and ensures lines are balanced and performing according to planning system rules.

**Continuous Improvement & Growth**

* Drives volume growth and productivity improvement by implementing Lean and continuous improvement methodologies across coating, curing, digital print, and material handling operations.
* Develops short- and long-term plans and programs for plant growth, including capacity, staffing, and capital investment roadmaps.
* Facilitates new product and new substrate/chemistry launches to assure successful implementation and rapid qualification.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Coordinates with support functions (Supply Chain and Planning, Continuous Improvement, Quality, Safety, Engineering, Finance, and Human Resources) to establish and implement systems supporting production operations goals.
* Partners with commercial teams on customer commitments, service levels, and cost-to-serve.

**People Leadership**

* Selects, develops, and retains qualified personnel in all positions reporting directly or indirectly; provides training, guidance, performance appraisals, and career development.

**Safety, Quality & Compliance**

* Responsible for compliance with all regulatory, corporate, and local policies (safety, environmental, quality, employment).
* Ensures a safe working environment and personally models and promotes safe work practices throughout the operation.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering or Business discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5+ years of experience in successful manufacturing operations, with demonstrated ownership of cost or P&L performance.
* 2+ years of experience in a direct people leadership position, with a track record of growing and developing direct reports.
* Familiarity with ERP systems (Oracle or equivalent) in a plant or departmental leadership capacity is a plus.

**Certifications & Licenses**

* Lean/Six Sigma certification preferred

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**

* Demonstrated track record applying Lean manufacturing techniques and leading in a team-based work environment.
* Business Operating System experience: Familiarity with Business Operating/Quality Systems or a comparable Lean Continuous Improvement framework, along with the analytical tools that support it, 80/20 root cause analysis, problem solving tool deployment, statistical process control (SPC), 5S, etc., with a demonstrated ability to use data to drive measurable improvements in safety, quality, OTIF and productivity.
* Business acumen and cost consciousness: understands the business implications of decisions, works within approved budgets, proactively develops cost-saving measures, and contributes to profit and revenue.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills; presents numerical data effectively to plant, functional, and executive audiences.Owns overall site performance and full P&L responsibility for the plant. Accountable for delivering Safety, Quality, Customer Service, and Cost commitments while building the organization, systems, and continuous improvement capability required to scale the operation from commissioning through full-rate production.

**Job Description:**

Hitachi Energy is recruiting for a Director of Operations. The role will be based in Jefferson City, Missouri manufacturing plant. This is Hitachi Energy's largest plant globally and we will offer relocation assistance. The role will be responsible for overseeing and optimizing all operational activities to ensure efficiency, productivity, and profitability across designated operational manufacturing value stream. This role requires a strategic leader capable of driving continuous improvement and fostering a culture of operational excellence.
 
 
Job Responsibilities
 
 

* Develop and implement operational strategies aligned with Hitachi's overall business objectives.
* Optimize workflows, processes, and systems to enhance operational efficiency and reduce costs.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and implement corrective actions to ensure targets are met or exceeded.
* Oversee budget planning, staffing, and management for operational departments, ensuring fiscal responsibility.
* Drive ITM (continuous improvement) initiatives through the adoption of ITM methodologies and best practices.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Engineering, Quality, HSSE, Process Engineering and downstream production departments.
* Develop and mentor operational teams, fostering a high-performance culture and promoting professional growth.
* Ensure compliance with all relevant industry regulations, quality standards, and company policies.
* Identify and mitigate operational risks, implementing robust contingency plans.

 
Job Qualifications
 
 

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in operations management, with at least 5 years in a senior people leadership role within a large-scale manufacturing organization.
* Proven track record of successfully leading and optimizing complex operational processes.
* Strong understanding of supply chain management, logistics, production planning, and quality control principles.
* Demonstrated experience with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and motivate diverse teams.
* Proficiency in enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems and other operational software.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Strong financial acumen with experience in budget management and cost control.

Location: Philadelphia, PA, United States
 
Date Posted: Nov 10, 2026

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.

 
 

**The Team**

At A&M, the North American Data and AI team, IQx (Official name to be announced) SBU is combining A&M's market-leading execution with AI and digital expertise to help clients redesign processes, improve performance and achieve better outcomes. Come be part of the launch of this cutting-edge team that is making an impact on A&M’s future. Join us in making a difference.

 

We are seeking a Operations Director to join our team. This position is an internal role within A&M’s IQx operations team, reporting directly to the COO and Finance lead for IQx.

 
 

We value a healthy work-life balance and promote in-person collaboration by providing a flexible remote work arrangement with select days in the office, as needed. Ideal office locations are New York City or Philadelphia, but this is flexible.

 
 

We offer excellent opportunities for career advancement and building leadership skills. Our business is committed to each team member’s development, training, and exposure to business leaders.

 
 

**How you will contribute**

As an Operationsirector, your primary responsibility will be for program management, resource management, onboarding activities, supporting the growth for our business, and helping us thrive to achieve our goals. The Operations Director is expected to grow to support the operations functions of the IQx business more broadly. Your primary responsibilities as we launch will include:

* Lead program management for IQx, including planning, tracking, and driving to completion the initiatives that support the launch and growth of the business
* Support and drive internal initiatives, coordinating across stakeholders, managing timelines and deliverables, and reporting progress to leadership
* Establish and run IQx meeting cadences (e.g., leadership, staffing, and pipeline reviews), including agendas, materials, action tracking, and follow-up
* Help set up and scale the IQx practice, building the operating processes, tools, and governance that will support the team as it grows
* Go-to person for all staffing matters for our business unit
* Assess and plan future resource requirements, driving utilization based on a thorough understanding of current and future project pipeline.
* Build relationships across the business with internal stakeholders including Senior Management, Talent Acquisition, HR, Finance and Operations teams
* Effectively plan for, and advise on conflicts and issues, on a regular basis, prioritizing based on commercial needs and key skills available
* Build awareness of individuals’ performance goals and development needs, influencing resourcing decisions that further the continuation of business and individuals’ skill-set development
* Advanced use of staffing/ workforce planning tools, AI and reporting (for example Profinda, Claude, PowerBI) in measuring utilization and influencing staffing decisions
* Collaborate extensively with the wider Resource Management teams across North America and globally, as required by project needs
 

 

**Qualifications**

The ideal candidate will be excited about becoming a true strategic partner for our business. We are looking for people who are personable, knowledgeable, entrepreneurial, and fun. A unique blend of qualities that cannot be fast-tracked into existence. You possess desirable qualities such as being anticipatory, engaged, and respectful, which earns the respect of others. Other preferred experience includes:

* Program management experience, with a track record of leading cross-functional initiatives, managing multiple workstreams, and setting up operating rhythms and meeting cadences
* Resource Manager with several years of experience in a consulting firm or matrix organization; experience in Ops, HR or Recruitment role also beneficial for the role
* Able to effectively partner with Business Leaders and other Resource Managers in the firm, working closely with the wider North America Resource Management leads
* Excellent relationship building skills, communicating with Business Leaders and staff
* Able to manage staffing by efficiently prioritizing multiple competing demands and dealing with tight deadlines
* Able to present meaningful reporting insights to senior leadership, delivering key resourcing messages and driving agreed-upon actions
* Degree educated with several years of work experience in a professional services or corporate environment
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, and knowledgeable in AI as well as resource planning tools
* Previous experience using a Resource Management/ Planning tool would be advantageous but not essential
* Keen to take on responsibility and grow the role
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, and drive positive change
* Strong time management skills with the ability to plan and priorities workload
* High degree of accuracy and attention to detail
* Use initiative to solve problems and make appropriate recommendations for resourcing decisions
* Works well under pressure and with challenging individuals
* Keen to take ownership of resourcing problems and motivated to deliver value
 

 

If you see yourself in this description, we want to hear from you!

 
 

*How will you grow and be supported?*

Our team prides itself on sustaining a culture that reflects our core values. We value integrity, quality, and objectivity in our work. We believe every day is a choice, and so we like what we do and with whom we do it. We embrace diversity, foster inclusiveness, and reward merit. We encourage and support our employees and communities through ongoing investments from leadership, social and networking events, peer-to-peer networks, Employee Resource Groups, volunteer opportunities, and pro-bono work. We are committed to promoting an inclusive environment in which all can develop, grow, and be supported.

 

**Your journey at A&M**

We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.

We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

 
 

Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive an annual discretionary contribution to their 401(k) retirement savings plan from Alvarez & Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A&M’s benefits programs.

 
 

The salary range is $150,000 - $170,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.

**Culture & Values**
--------------------

At Alvarez & Marsal, our core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide everything we do, shaping a culture rooted in entrepreneurship, impact, and integrity. We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. Above all, we value doing the right thing. For those ready to roll up their sleeves, lead with integrity, and be difference makers, this is where it starts.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

It is Alvarez & Marsal’s practice to provide and promote equal opportunity in employment, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment without discrimination because of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex or gender, gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, family medical history, genetic information or other protected medical condition, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by and in accordance with applicable laws. Employees and Applicants can find A&M policy statements and additional information by region here.

**Unsolicited Resumes from Third-Party Recruiters**
---------------------------------------------------

Please note that as per A&M policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters unless such recruiters are engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that A&M will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.
